minimum_proof: P002 has simultaneous melody, independently sustained upper inner chord, moving lower tenor, and independent bass. Fewer than four would merge independent lines.

line_identities.1: upper melody, including chordal upper passages
line_identities.2: upper inner / moving figure, with eight lower-staff cross-staff visits
line_identities.4: bass / lower chordal line / shared lower rests

silent_gap_policy: Use time transport for absent voice segments, no added printed rests. No all-rest lane. Shared printed rests are serialized once.
chordal_transition_policy: Same-stem chordal passages share a voice; opposed stems remain separate even at equal onset and duration. Member ties may branch from a shared chord into a separate continuing line.
sep_lane_coordinate_convention: Exporter zero-based staff/part index, not MusicXML one-based staff number
